{{Vanilla}}
The '''lava bucket''' is unchanged from vanilla ''Minecraft''. In Matcha Flavoured it is an ingredient of [[Magma Block|magma blocks]] (a lava bucket and a stone material make 2), and the [[Engineer]]'s [[Geothermal Bundle]] contains four of them, stackable to 64.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/magma_block_from_lava_and_stone.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/armorer/5/lava_kit.json}}</ref> See {{MCW|Lava Bucket}}.
